ideas.title: SLP-style vector dense resets
ideas.summary: Rust dense cost is flat at ~2.7k cycles per factor: LLVM vectorises its word-ordered load/OR/store into AVX2. Ours stays scalar (~1.6x the cycles for small factors).

cycles.source: Zen 4 (9V74) and Zen 5 (9V45), TSC timers per phase, 1T, 3 rounds within 0.1%.
notes: Base gap to Rust: 51k cycles a pass on Zen 4 (dense 35k, sparse 8k) and 49k on Zen 5 (dense 29k, sparse 15k).
Rust dense costs a flat ~2.7k cycles per factor: LLVM SLP-vectorises it. Ours is scalar.
